story.iWant: start and initialize database services automatically
story.soThat: the application has reliable data storage support ready for use
story.tasks: - Task 1: Redis Service Startup and Verification (AC: 1) - Subtask 1.1: Implement Redis service detection and startup logic - Subtask 1.2: Integrate HealthChecker for Redis connection verification - Subtask 1.3: Implement Redis ready state monitoring - Subtask 1.4: Add Redis service configuration management - Task 2: PostgreSQL Service Startup and Configuration (AC: 2) - Subtask 2.1: Implement PostgreSQL service detection and startup logic - Subtask 2.2: Create application database and user permissions - Subtask 2.3: Verify PostgreSQL connection and permissions - Subtask 2.4: Configure PostgreSQL connection parameters - Task 3: Database Initialization and Migration (AC: 3) - Subtask 3.1: Implement database migration script execution engine - Subtask 3.2: Create table structure initialization logic - Subtask 3.3: Implement migration version control and rollback mechanism - Subtask 3.4: Verify database structure integrity - Task 4: Base Data Import (AC: 4) - Subtask 4.1: Implement base data import logic - Subtask 4.2: Create data validation and integrity checking - Subtask 4.3: Implement data import error handling and recovery - Subtask 4.4: Verify system basic functionality availability - Task 5: Database Performance Verification (AC: 5) - Subtask 5.1: Implement database performance benchmark testing - Subtask 5.2: Create response time monitoring mechanism - Subtask 5.3: Add performance metrics collection and reporting - Subtask 5.4: Implement performance optimization suggestion generation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Start Redis service and verify connection availability 2. Start PostgreSQL service and create application database 3. Execute database migration scripts to initialize table structure 4. Import base data to ensure system can run normally 5. Verify database service performance to ensure response times are normal

artifact.reason: Existing Redis service management with cross-platform startup capabilities
Existing PostgreSQL service management with connection testing
Database configuration management with port detection and secure password generation
Main database service orchestrator (to be implemented)
Service dependency validation and startup sequence management
Connection-based health checking for Redis and PostgreSQL
Port allocation and conflict detection for Redis:6379 and PostgreSQL:5432

dependency.reason: PostgreSQL advanced features and connection pooling

constraints.constraint: Service startup sequence must follow Redis → PostgreSQL order as defined in service dependency analysis
Use existing HealthChecker class for connection-based verification
Follow unified error format {code, message, solution, details}
Implement async operations using asyncio patterns for concurrent database operations
Port allocation must use existing PortManager for Redis:6379 and PostgreSQL:5432
Configuration management must leverage ServiceConfigurator for database-specific configurations
Maintain snake_case naming convention for files and PascalCase for classes
All database operations must include proper error handling and user-friendly messages

tests.standards: Comprehensive test suite using pytest with mocking for database connections. Test patterns established in previous stories include service startup testing, connection verification, migration execution, data import validation, and performance benchmarking. Tests must cover cross-platform scenarios and error handling.

Test database migration script execution with sample migration files
Test base data import with validation and error recovery

Test complete database service startup flow with service sequence validation
